concept: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL routing of subagents to a small local model
summary: Before v2.1.251 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` came first in the order and overrode the per-invocation parameter and the frontmatter, including `model: inherit`.

facts.text: Before v2.1.251 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` came first in the order and overrode the per-invocation parameter and the frontmatter, including `model: inherit`.
Setting the variable to `inherit` is the same as leaving it unset; before v2.1.196 that value forced subagents onto the main conversation's model.
Setting `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` by itself does not change the model that the built-in Explore and Plan subagents run on.
Under a Claude subscription, a Console account or an LLM gateway reached through `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, the built-in Explore subagent runs on the model the `opus` alias resolves to.
A user or project subagent named `Explore` overrides the built-in and keeps its own `model` field, so `model: haiku` in it moves exploration to a cheaper model.
With `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1`, Claude Code ignores the `model` field in subagent definitions and Claude cannot pass a model when it starts a subagent.
If only `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` is set, subagents run on the main conversation's model, except that built-in Explore runs on the model listed for it under built-in subagents.
A fork and a skill that runs in a subagent with `model: inherit` stay on the main conversation's model even while force is on.
An alias in `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` always resolves to the version the alias points to, even when it names the main model's family.

A family alias such as `opus` in the per-invocation parameter or the frontmatter resolves to the main conversation's exact model, including a `[1m]` suffix, when the main model belongs to that family.

Claude Code checks the per-invocation, frontmatter and variable values against the organisation's `availableModels`; a blocked family alias runs on the newest allowed version of the family, other blocked values run on the inherited model, and an interactive session shows a warning naming both models.
`/tasks` shows the model each running subagent uses, from v2.1.242, so it is the check that a small local model took effect.

When a configured fallback model chain covers a subagent's failure, Claude Code moves that subagent to the first model in the chain that accepts the request, from v2.1.247, and leaves the session model unchanged.

The variable accepts an alias such as `haiku` or a full model name; Claude Code does not check a model set by `--model`, `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or the `model` setting up front, and a mistyped value fails at request time.

This CONTRADICTS the unqualified wording in local-router-policy-keyed-on-x-claude-code-reque.md that the variable sets the default for subagents with a short override note: the full order is per-invocation `model`, then definition `model` frontmatter (`inherit` selects the main model), then `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`, then the main conversation's model.
